verification.validation: Frontend-only release. Required before publication: the SDK frontend unit tests, the real-browser AppShell layout check (desktop and 390px), the frontend build and npm pack, and the private-policy content/diff/artifact scans on this release candidate. Executor sources and canonical tasks are unchanged and the immutable executor/v0.49.5 inventory is reused. No NAS acceptance is implied.

changes: AppShell pages show no visible title by default: a visually hidden h1 names the page, and its actions and notes sit in a page bar above it. header: true keeps the PageHeader; page descriptions are no longer shown.

Only the content scrolls: a page that shows a SettingsPage or a SectionTabs fill fills the height through the App's wrappers, its tab strip and settings footer stay, and a settings footer has no space under it in or out of tabs. fill: false opts out.
